title: Client Ops: Weekly Sync + Integration Playbook Notes — 2028-08-03
content:
Meeting: Client Ops Weekly Sync — SE + ProServices
Date: 2028-08-03
Time: 10:00–11:00 PT
Owner/Facilitator: Asha Patel
Attendees: Asha P., Liam C., Riley M., Noah K., Sofia A., Erin (CS), Victor (SRE) — plus TPMs for AtlasPay and Veridian pre-call
Objective: Surface customer integration status, unblock highest-risk deliveries, align on rollout windows and on-call coverage for next two weeks.

Quick summary (1-liner):
- Overall throughput steady; two customers (AtlasPay, Veridian Health) flagged yellow -> technical I/O and infra scaling; NovaRetail on green but needs final UX signoff.

Notes / discussion highlights:

1) AtlasPay — payments integration (priority: high)
- Current phase: end-to-end sandbox validation; first production canary target moved from 2028-08-10 -> 2028-08-17 due to intermittent 503s at tokenization boundary.
- Symptoms: ~2% of requests see stall during prefix cache warmup when payment session context > 4k tokens. Error surfaces as 503/timeout on hosted API layer; not full GPU OOM.
- Investigation: Victor (SRE) traced to connection churn in gateway pool when backend VPC routing hits a specific Nic configuration on AtlasPay side. Repro locally with simulated traffic pattern.
- Temporary mitigations: increase gateway connection pool to 200 for AtlasPay route; enable longer idle-keepalive. Practice: apply on staging, monitor for 24h before prod canary.
- Long-term: platform infra to add sticky routing for persistent sessions or KV-cache-prefetch heuristics. Engineering owner: Liam Chen.
- Risks: schedule slip for early adopters; billing/cost implications from extended warm cache.
- Action items: see action list.

2) Veridian Health — private deployment (priority: critical/compliance)
- Current phase: private control plane rollout to customer VPC (on-prem proxy + HSM integration).
- Blocker: HSM vendor requires TLS mutual-auth config that conflicts with our current private control plane cert rotation script. Rotation script currently fails for cert chain with mTLS CA.
- Discussion: solution options — modify rotation script to support mTLS CA chain OR operator-managed cert rotation and documented manual steps. Customer requires automated rotation to meet compliance.
- Decision: implement mTLS-aware rotation in private-deploy branch (opt-in), target patch release 2028-08-09. Noah Kim + Private Deploy Eng to own.
- Risk: high (compliance SLA). Need dedicated test harness with vendor HSM emulator.

3) NovaRetail — hosted API onboarding (priority: medium)
- Current phase: acceptance testing for chat+functions. UX team surfaced a mismatch in function-call payload schema that causes a downstream renderer to show truncated metadata.
- Root cause: older frontend expected 'meta.tags' array; backend function return used 'meta_tag' string.
- Fix: small protobuf/schema patch being prepared by Riley — back-compat shim to return both properties for 2 release cycles.
- Customer wants go-live 2028-08-15 pending UX signoff.

4) Shared concerns / cross-customer items
- Batching config: recent workload changes causing tokenization spikes; Optimize team suggested lowering max-batch-time from 15ms -> 10ms for chat endpoints for low-latency customers. Need to roll A/B for 48h window.
- Observability: add a per-route metric for KV-cache hit latency (not just hit rate). Instrumentation ticket: JIRA-2012 (linked).
- Capacity/ops: Dedicated pool capacity is tight week of 2028-08-14 due to two planned customer canaries + internal perf tests. Proposed: shift internal perf test to 2028-08-20 or provision 1 extra GPU for three days.

5) On-call & escalation playbook updates
- Small changes agreed:
  * When a customer private-deploy fails TLS negotiation, page SRE on-call + private-deploy lead.
  * For hosted 503 patterns > 1% sustained for 2 min, automatically spin a fallback route to smaller model variant as emergency mitigation. Product to formalize threshold.
- Owner for playbook edits: Sofia Alvarez. Target: 2028-08-07.

Open/Action items (numbered):
1) Increase gateway connection pool for AtlasPay on staging and monitor 24h. Owner: Victor (SRE). Due: 2028-08-04.
2) Implement sticky routing prototype for session affinity (infra spike engineering work). Owner: Liam Chen. Due: 2028-08-17.
3) Patch mTLS-aware cert rotation in private-deploy branch and create HSM emulator tests. Owner: Noah Kim + Private Deploy Eng. Due: 2028-08-09.
4) Release schema shim for function-call metadata (back-compat) and schedule frontend regression testing with NovaRetail. Owner: Riley Martinez. Due: 2028-08-06.
5) Open instrumentation ticket for KV-cache hit latency and assign dashboard card. Owner: Erin (CS) + Observability. JIRA-2012. Due: 2028-08-05.
6) Decide internal perf test reschedule or temporary GPU allocation; finance to approve burst cost. Owner: Asha Patel (prod + infra coordination). Due: 2028-08-06.
7) Update on-call playbook and escalation matrix to include private-deploy mTLS flows. Owner: Sofia Alvarez. Due: 2028-08-07.
8) Customer comms draft for AtlasPay explaining slip and mitigations; send by EOD. Owner: CS — Erin. Due: 2028-08-03 (EOD).

Decisions made in meeting:
- Opt to implement automated mTLS-aware cert rotation in private-deploy (rather than manual ops) due to compliance requirements.
- Gate AtlasPay production canary on 24-hour staging stability after connection pool change.

Risks and notes to execs (short bullets):
- Veridian Health remains highest compliance risk until HSM cert rotation patch is validated; recommend prioritizing Private Deploy Eng resourcing for next 7 days.
- Potential 1-week slip for AtlasPay canary if gateway mitigation shows partial effectiveness; recommend CS contingency plan for customer communications.

Misc/quick todos (notes to self):
- Follow up with Finance on burst GPU quote (slack thread #infra-burst).
- Add NovaRetail UX signoff to next week's agenda and capture exact screenshot examples.
- Draft a short blurb for Product on the function-call schema change so customers know about two-release compatibility shim.

Next meeting: 2028-08-10, 10:00 PT (standard time) — focus on production canaries results, HSM emulator test run, and batching A/B results.

Raw meeting transcript/snippets: (copied from call)
- Liam: "If the cache warmup is the symptom we can prefetch based on session cookie and avoid the initial stall."
- Victor: "I can reproduce the 503 pattern in staging with a sustained 800RPS burst pattern; will push the connection-pool change now."
- Noah: "We need the HSM emulator — vendor provided a binary image we can run in the lab; I'll coordinate with infra."
